---
title: "Custom Language Compiler"
subtitle: "A compiler built from scratch in C with Flex and Bison"
---

A compiler for a custom language, built in C using Flex and Bison, implementing the full front to back pipeline.

[View source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/custom-language-compiler){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## What it covers

- **Lexical analysis**: tokenizing source code with Flex.
- **Semantic analysis**: checking that programs are well formed.
- **AST generation**: building an abstract syntax tree.
- **Code translation**: turning the tree into output code.

## Why it is relevant to quant work

Building a compiler demands low level rigor and careful, correct systems work, the same discipline needed when performance and correctness of numerical pipelines matter.

## Tech

C, Flex, Bison.
